data.title: Volvo Excellence brings nearly a century of safety innovation to life
data.description: For nearly a century, Volvo Cars has pursued a simple belief: safety should be for everyone.

data.title: KingsQuare Residence Moves Forward Towards Handover of Luxury Residences on Rama III
data.description: KingsQuare Residence, a luxury residential project in the Rama III area, is moving towards welcoming residents to experience the project’s concept of “From a Second Home to the First Home of the Family.” Through thoughtful design, construction quality and hospitality-inspired services, the project aims to support the long-term living needs of modern families. Approximately 99% of the 222 residential units are ready, with a project value of 6.5 billion baht. Unit inspections are scheduled to begin in mid-November 2026.

data.title: Thai FDA steps up enoki mushroom import checks after US Listeria alert
data.description: The Thai FDA says initial checks found no enoki imports from the flagged producer and urges thorough cooking as it increases testing of imported mushrooms.

data.title: Sida khon blessing ceremony held ahead of November 5 opening
data.description: The SUPPORT Foundation’s October 27 ceremony at Bangkok’s Thailand Cultural Centre was followed by rehearsals for its Ramakien production.

data.title: 260kg of ‘ice’ seized after shootout with smugglers
data.description: Army troops seized 261.5 kilogrammes of crystal methamphetamine, or “ice”, following a gunfight with suspected drug smugglers in Mae Sai district of Chiang Rai in the early hours of Wednesday.

data.title: ‘Eat the rich’: Indonesians fed up with graft, wildfires
data.description: JAKARTA - Hundreds of Indonesians gathered in central Jakarta on Wednesday to protest against economic hardship, graft and the government’s handling of devastating wildfires causing toxic haze that has sickened thousands.

data.title: Flavio Bolsonaro on way to Ecuador after fleeing Brazil
data.description: BUENOS AIRES - Defeated right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro was on his way to Ecuador after fleeing Brazil, Argentina’s government said on Wednesday.

data.title: 3 arrested in Japan with rare tortoises from Thailand
data.description: OSAKA — A high school student and two men have been arrested on suspicion of attempting to smuggle rare tortoises and other animals from Thailand in violation of the Customs Act, police said on Wednesday.

data.title: Netanyahu bloc leads after half of Israeli votes counted but no majority
data.description: JERUSALEM - The camp of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was ahead of his rival's opposition bloc but still short of a majority on Wednesday after 50 percent of votes were counted in Israel's pivotal general election.

data.title: Accused poster of fake Anutin ‘tea money’ slip arrested
data.description: The man accused of posting a fake transaction slip on the “Godd Dam” Facebook page showing a purported 7-million-baht transfer to then-deputy prime minister Anutin Charnvirakul was arrested on Wednesday.

data.title: Pierce Brosnan and Helen Mirren on the joys of filming 'MobLand'
data.description: LOS ANGELES — Pierce Brosnan and Helen Mirren have found they quite enjoy mob life, as they embody the dangerous and volatile criminal boss couple Conrad and Maeve Harrigan in " MobLand ."

data.title: India vows action after first cheetah shot dead
data.description: NEW DELHI — India has vowed "swift action" after a cheetah was shot dead, the first such killing since the country began reintroducing the animals in 2022, the government said Wednesday.

data.title: S.African activists push back on data centre rush
data.description: CAPE TOWN — A little boy balanced a large bottle of water on his shoulder as he returned from a communal tap near land acquired by a major data centre developer in South Africa's water-scarce city of Cape Town.

data.title: 200 ‘cruise for life’ passengers stranded in Cambodia
data.description: Around 200 passengers who paid to live on a cruise ship while travelling the world were abruptly left in a Cambodian port after the company ran out of money, an official said on Wednesday.

data.title: Mbappe furore rages on in China, but Mao comments censored
data.description: BEIJING — Kylian Mbappe struggled to dissipate anger on Chinese social media on Wednesday despite apologising for his comments on Mao Zedong that cost him several commercial deals in the huge market.

data.title: Foreigner falls to death from Pattaya condo
data.description: A foreign man, whose nationality has yet been identified, reportedly fell to his death from a high-rise condominium on Sukhumvit Road in Pattaya early on Wednesday morning.

data.title: Asean envoy to lead humanitarian mission to Myanmar
data.description: MANILA — ⁠The ⁠Association of Southeast Asian Nations' (Asean) ​special envoy on Myanmar will lead a ​humanitarian mission to the ‌country starting on Wednesday, Asean chair the Philippines said.

data.title: 'Now or Never': Ethiopia influencers push for Eritrea invasion
data.description: ADDIS ABABA - Ethiopian online influencers are pushing for their government to invade neighbouring Eritrea and seize access to the sea, following its success against rebel and Eritrean forces in recent weeks.

data.title: Judges set to rule on Australian mushroom killer's appeal
data.description: SYDNEY - Australian mushroom murderer Erin Patterson will learn Friday if she has succeeded in overturning her conviction for killing three people with a poisoned beef Wellington lunch.
